title: Townsend Brown crash retrievals and green fireball

tellings.quote: like the late '50s, early '60s, where he would go into the field and and find stuff, flashes credentials, do crash retrievals, basically. And like he found this green fireball thing and it was losing mass and apparently that was barium titanate.

plain: In the late 1950s and early 1960s, the inventor Thomas Townsend Brown is said to have gone into the field, shown official credentials, and recovered crashed unknown objects, what the subject calls crash retrievals. Michels, talking with a guest named Dave Rossi, says Brown found a "green fireball" object that was losing mass, and that it was apparently made of barium titanate, a ceramic material that reacts to electric charge. Michels tells it himself, without naming a source; if true, it would place Brown inside secret recovery work.
